scope: Samples were lysed in a buffer consisting of 50 mM Tris (pH 8.5), 8 M urea, 1% SDS, supplemented with protease and phosphatase inhibitors.

Proteins were extracted from 2 x 106 to 3 x 106 cells, cells were pelleted at 300 x g for 5 minutes at room temperature. Pellets were washed with ice cold PBS then lysed using RIPA lysis buffer (Cell Signaling) supplemented with Phosphatase Inhibitor Cocktails (Santa Cruz Biotechnology). Lysates were centrifuged at 12000 x g for 15 minutes at 4°C and supernatant was kept at -80°C for further uses.
